config.title: Berlin Central Bus Station - FAQ
config.subtitle: Arriving in Berlin by FlixBus or another coach: where the ZOB is, how to reach the city centre, and when a different stop is the smarter choice.

items.q: Where is the central bus station in Berlin?
items.a: The ZOB, short for Zentraler Omnibusbahnhof, is at **Messedamm 8 in Westend**, next to the Funkturm radio tower and the exhibition grounds. It has a waiting hall, ticket counters, **luggage lockers**, toilets, a bakery and a kiosk. It is not in the city centre: Alexanderplatz is about 7 km east.

items.q: How do I get from the ZOB to Alexanderplatz or Mitte?
items.a: Walk about 300 m to **U Kaiserdamm** and take the U-Bahn toward the centre; it reaches Zoologischer Garten in about 8 minutes and **Alexanderplatz in about 30**. A single AB ticket for **4.00 EUR** covers the whole ride. For the Ring stations, S Messe Nord/ZOB is right by the bus platforms.

items.q: Does FlixBus stop anywhere in Berlin besides the ZOB?
items.a: **Yes, at eight other stops**: Alexanderplatz, Hauptbahnhof, Zoologischer Garten, Suedkreuz, Ostbahnhof, Treptower Park, Wannsee and Alt-Tegel, plus BER airport. Not every ride serves every stop, so check the stop list for your exact departure when you book and pick the one nearest your hotel.

items.q: What ticket do I need from the bus station into Berlin?
items.a: A **single AB ticket for 4.00 EUR** covers any onward ride inside the city, with changes, for two hours in one direction. A **24-hour AB ticket costs 11.20 EUR** and pays off from the third ride. Buy it in the BVG app or at the machines, and validate paper tickets before boarding. BER airport needs an ABC ticket for 5.00 EUR.

items.q: Is the ZOB safe at night, and how do I leave it after midnight?
items.a: The ZOB is a normal working bus station with staff and a lit waiting hall; the area around it is quiet rather than rough. On weeknights the U-Bahn stops around 1:00 and the **N2 night bus from Kaiserdamm** runs to Alexanderplatz in about 40 minutes. On Friday and Saturday nights the U-Bahn keeps running all night.
